environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL contains three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 100 in COUNT mode for telemetry, (2) a custom rule at priority 200 that applies a rate limit of 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP with action BLOCK, (3) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet at priority 300 in BLOCK mode. The ALB target group performs health checks on /health. Additionally, the ECS task role has an IAM permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/DenyNetworkEgress) that denies ec2:*, s3:* and all network-related actions, limiting blast radius. CloudWatch Logs Insights runs a scheduled query every 60 seconds alerting on any audit_log entry containing SQL keywords.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 WebACL attached
config.compute: ECS Fargate, task role with permissions boundary DenyNetworkEgress
config.monitoring: CloudWatch Logs Insights scheduled query on audit_log for SQL keyword patterns, 60s interval
config.network: Private subnet, ALB in public subnet, no direct access to task
